title: aglaia mirabilis
intro: Aglaia mirabilis, commonly known as the Mirabilis Tree or Thai Aloe, is a species of plant in the family Meliaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include treating fever, diarrhea, and skin infections. The health benefits of Aglaia mirabilis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Aglaia mirabilis include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
